scientific_integrity.asserted_claim: Of 4352 nonzero-outer-coefficient equations \(y^2=ax^{12}+bx^4+c\) over \(\mathbb F_{17}\), 4096 are smooth genus five and exactly 32 are pointless; all 32 lie in one diagonal isomorphism orbit.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No global genus-five or full automorphism-group classification; existence without family rigidity is older; historical uniqueness unproved.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Cubic discriminant, exhaustive fourth-power residue criterion and four normalized coefficient pairs forming one diagonal orbit.
scientific_integrity.scope: Coefficient-marked 3-term genus-five hyperelliptic curves with a canonical cyclic-four quotient to an elliptic curve over F17.

title: One pointless class in a cyclic-four genus-five family over \(\mathbb F_{17}\)
